updates.title: Trump eases sanctions on Russian diesel, and Republicans join Democrats in pushing back
updates.summary: A Treasury license through April 7, 2027 lets Russian diesel into the U.S. market, and critics in both parties say it rewards Putin.

updates.title: Trump's Russian diesel deal draws bipartisan fire as Kyiv says it was never consulted
updates.summary: Zelensky calls the deal a gift to Putin, Trump says Ukraine needs a new president, and Republicans in Congress push back.

updates.title: Republicans split over Trump's Russian diesel deal as Kyiv says the 'energy ceasefire' is not holding
updates.summary: Four Republican senators joined Democrats against the deal, Fitzpatrick plans a discharge petition, and Lavrov rejected the energy ceasefire Trump announced.

updates.title: Four Republican senators join Democrats against Trump's Russian diesel deal as he says critics 'can't be serious'
updates.summary: Collins, Murkowski, Tillis and Curtis say the sanctions relief breaks the law, and Trump says he made the right choice.

updates.title: Republican senators keep pressing Trump to reverse his Russian diesel deal as he says he made 'the right choice'
updates.summary: Four Republican senators joined Democrats against the deal, and Trump answered on Truth Social that he made the right choice for the American people.

updates.title: Bipartisan letter calls Trump's Russian diesel deal a betrayal as an Oct. 18 sanctions deadline nears
updates.summary: Senators from both parties urge Trump to scrap the Treasury license, while analysts doubt the deal will cut U.S. diesel prices.

updates.title: Bipartisan senators demand Trump rescind the Russian diesel license as the White House defends it
updates.summary: A letter from Republicans and Democrats calls the deal a gift to Moscow, while analysts doubt it will lower U.S. diesel prices.

updates.title: Trump rules out Iran strikes before the midterms as a Houthi attack kills 12 at Riyadh's airport
updates.summary: Indirect Iran talks continue, while a deadly Houthi missile strike in Saudi Arabia raises the chance of wider U.S. involvement.

updates.title: Riyadh airport death toll reaches 13 as Trump says the U.S. may join the fight against the Houthis
updates.summary: Trump rules out striking Iran before Nov. 3 but keeps open a role against the Houthis in Yemen.

updates.title: Riyadh airport death toll reaches 13 as Trump says the U.S. may join the fight against the Houthis
updates.summary: Trump rules out striking Iran before Nov. 3 but keeps open a role against the Houthis in Yemen.

updates.title: Riyadh airport stays shut after Houthi strikes kill 13 as Trump weighs joining Saudi attacks
updates.summary: Saudi Arabia is pressing Washington to act, while Houthis threaten a swift response against U.S. interests.

updates.title: Riyadh airport stays shut through at least Oct. 17 as Trump weighs joining Saudi strikes on the Houthis
updates.summary: After a Houthi attack that killed 13, Trump says Iran is probably behind the group's return while the Houthis threaten a 'swift and painful' response.

updates.title: Houthi missiles hit a Saudi Aramco building as Trump holds off on Iran strikes until after the midterms
updates.summary: Riyadh's airport stays closed through Oct. 17, Iran attacks ships near Hormuz, and Brent crude sits above $100.

updates.title: Houthi-Saudi fighting and tanker attacks keep Brent above $106 while Trump holds off on Iran strikes
updates.summary: Saudi Arabia extended the Riyadh airport closure through Oct. 17, and Iran has stepped up attacks near Hormuz.

updates.title: Trump's approval falls to 30 percent in Pew as the Senate stays a toss-up
updates.summary: Pew puts Trump at 30 percent approval, near his career low, with 23 days left before the Nov. 3 midterms.

updates.title: Republicans shift money to defend red seats as Democrats widen the Senate map
updates.summary: CNN reports a GOP triage mode with three weeks left, while polls show Democrats competitive in Ohio, Kansas, Texas and Alaska.

updates.title: Republicans shift money to defend red seats as Democrats widen the Senate map
updates.summary: CNN reports a GOP triage mode with three weeks left, while polls show Democrats competitive in Ohio, Kansas, Texas and Alaska.

updates.title: Trump's approval sits at 30 percent in Pew as forecasters edge Senate races toward Democrats
updates.summary: Republicans still hold a narrow edge for the Senate, but Fox and Sabato's Crystal Ball both show the map tightening.

updates.title: Senate debates in Maine, Georgia and Iowa and a Trump rally in Alaska headline a big campaign night
updates.summary: Pew puts Trump's approval at 30 percent as Republicans defend seats in several states with the Senate away until November.

updates.title: Senate debates in Georgia, Maine and Iowa turn on Trump, Epstein and the Russia diesel deal
updates.summary: Iowa's Ashley Hinson broke with Trump on the diesel deal, while Georgia's Ossoff and Collins clashed over Epstein files and 2020.

updates.title: Trump's Alaska rally for Sen. Dan Sullivan puts a tight race and falling approval in focus
updates.summary: Trump spoke about 90 minutes in Wasilla, pardoned two diesel mechanics and touted a gas pipeline while a CNN poll of polls has his approval at 33%.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax is narrowly ahead, but two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: Prop. 40 leads in recent polls, Newsom opposes it, and Props. 41 and 42 would void it if they get more votes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax holds a narrow lead as rival measures and a $91 million PAC loom
updates.summary: PPIC has Prop. 40 at 52-46, but Props. 41 and 42 poll higher and could void it if they win more votes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax holds a narrow lead as rival measures and a $91 million PAC loom
updates.summary: PPIC has Prop. 40 at 52-46, but Props. 41 and 42 poll higher and could void it if they win more votes.

updates.title: Prop. 40 holds a narrow lead, but Props. 41 or 42 could void it even if it passes
updates.summary: PPIC has the billionaire tax at 52-46, while two rival measures poll higher and Newsom plans to vote no.

updates.title: Prop. 40 billionaire tax leads narrowly, but Props. 41 and 42 could cancel it even if it passes
updates.summary: A one-time 5% tax on billionaires polls ahead while Sergey Brin's money backs two measures that could void it.

updates.title: Prop. 40 billionaire tax leads narrowly while Brin-backed rivals could cancel it
updates.summary: PPIC has the one-time 5% tax at 52-46, but Props. 41 and 42 poll higher and Newsom backs one of them.

updates.title: Opponents of California's billionaire tax have raised more than $205 million, led by Sergey Brin
updates.summary: Backers of Props. 40 to 42 face a lopsided money gap even as PPIC polling shows Prop. 40 narrowly ahead.
